entities.name: Hugh II, Duke of Burgundy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hugh II was Duke of Burgundy between 1103 and 1143. Hugh was son of Odo I, Duke of Burgundy. Hugh was selected custos for the monastery of St. Benigne, and this office would be held by his descendants until the end of the twelfth century.
